source.lapis_dirty_scope: Architecture triage only: docs/architecture.md, docs/status.md and this sanitized evidence receipt.

scope: Decision triage over the merged architecture after PRs #147-#149. It selects the next bounded implementation slice and records current-head R1 evidence; it changes no runtime behavior.

inputs.name: architecture-and-status
inputs.result: Open choices, production delivery order, execution scoring and readiness tables were inspected at main 31567c4.

inputs.name: r1-source-audit
inputs.result: Mapped GUI birth, state/runtime/control, real-service launcher, CMake and focused checker ownership; proposed the one-session birth-broker slice.

inputs.name: r4-source-audit
inputs.result: Confirmed candidate-gate enforcement is merged and identified the local ad-hoc signed package path plus parent-owned publication gates.

inputs.name: codex-next-audit
inputs.result: Compared explicit thread switching, external-agent import onboarding, embedded/local-daemon worktree adoption and permission-rule semantics; explicit service-owned switching is the narrowest next Codex slice, but R1 remains first globally.

rank_order: R1 headless birth broker behind LAPIS_BUILD_SUPERVISOR_RUNTIME
R4 local signed-scope package verification at the next candidate
Codex external-agent import onboarding and other post-P1 adoptions

r1_slice.target: Add an opt-in lapis_supervisor_daemon without changing normal GUI birth.
r1_slice.request_contract: Same effective-UID peer, no active session slot, bounded literal agent launch fields and fingerprint; daemon-selected service executable; no environment override.
r1_slice.reply_contract: Return supervisor-selected session ID and epoch only; never expose the spawn token.
required_observations: daemon is a separate process from service and terminal child
real lapis_session_service starts around a harmless terminal child
authoritative reconnect and joined second client preserve identity
hello preserves the terminal child PID
explicit stop removes service, terminal child and ownership record

decision.r4_position: Local package_macos.py app plus verify is the next local release-slice check, but an installed update cannot claim independent service birth before R1; publication and the six candidate gates remain parent-owned.
decision.codex_position: Explicit thread switch is the next Codex slice after P2. The first switch implementation should accept an exact persistent thread ID only while no decision-capable request is pending, rotate the attention epoch, reconcile the target by resume/read and reject every old token. External-agent import onboarding remains broader and is not ahead of R1.

validation.name: current-head-r1-focused-gate
validation.result: Configure, targeted build and supervisor-state/runtime/real-service CTest passed; real-service integration was observed rather than skipped.

validation.name: current-head-quality
validation.result: Repository contracts, diff hygiene, Ruff check/format and Python unit tests passed at merged main before this documentation edit.

failed_attempts.result: The first configure failed because the r1 preset cache had an empty LAPIS_GHOSTTY_PREFIX.
failed_attempts.repair: The checkout's validated pinned Ghostty prefix was seeded into build/r1-runtime before rerunning the unchanged checker; the focused gate then passed.

non_claims: This is a planning and evidence-only change; no daemon, GUI, package or adapter behavior was implemented.
The current-head supervisor pass does not qualify GUI birth, launchd, daemon persistence, reboot, package replacement, selected-account environment admission, load, memory, latency or sanitizers.
Worker audits are source inspection and do not replace the parent-owned build, live-service and eventual native/package acceptance runs.
R4 publication, notarization, appcast, update and rollback gates remain unclaimed.
